questions.q: The potential energy of a particle varies with position x as U(x) = ax² - bx, where a and b are positive constants. The force acting on the particle is:
questions.qPa: ਇੱਕ ਕਣ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਊਰਜਾ U(x) = ax² - bx ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਬਦਲਦੀ ਹੈ। ਕਣ 'ਤੇ ਲੱਗਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਬਲ ਕੀ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ?
questions.explanation: Force F = -dU/dx. Taking the derivative: dU/dx = 2ax - b. Therefore, F = -(2ax - b) = -2ax + b.

questions.q: A particle of mass m moving with velocity v collides perfectly inelastically with a stationary particle of mass 2m. What fraction of the initial kinetic energy is lost?
questions.qPa: v ਵੇਗ ਨਾਲ ਚੱਲ ਰਿਹਾ m ਪੁੰਜ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਕਣ, 2m ਪੁੰਜ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਥਿਰ ਕਣ ਨਾਲ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਅਸਥਿਰ (perfectly inelastic) ਟਕਰਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤੀ ਗਤੀ ਊਰਜਾ ਦਾ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Fraction of KE lost in a perfectly inelastic collision with a stationary target is M/(m+M). Here target mass M = 2m. Fraction = 2m / (m + 2m) = 2/3.

questions.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of a conservative force?
options: Work done depends on the path taken.
Work done in a closed loop is always greater than zero.
Work done in a closed loop is always zero.
questions.explanation: A defining property of a conservative force (like gravity or electrostatic force) is that the total work done by it on a particle moving around any closed path is zero.

questions.q: In a 1D elastic collision between two bodies, what is the value of the coefficient of restitution (e)?
questions.explanation: For an perfectly elastic collision, the relative velocity of separation equals the relative velocity of approach, hence e = 1.
